name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: GoHighLevel CRM Specialist | Workflows, Funnels, Integrations & CRM Governance
summary: GoHighLevel CRM architect who builds and runs client environments end to end: discovery, pipelines, workflows, funnels, email and SMS, integrations, and training. At Solenzo I built a 20+ workflow GoHighLevel system covering capture, routing, qualification, booking, no-show recovery, onboarding, reactivation, and reviews. I integrate through webhooks, APIs, Zapier, Make, and n8n, and have cleaned CRMs of 1,400+ contacts.

experience.title: GoHighLevel CRM Architect — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architected a 20+ workflow GoHighLevel system: lead capture, tagging and routing, qualification, calendar booking with confirmations and reminders, no-show recovery, post-sale onboarding, nurture and reactivation, and automated review requests.
Run discovery with business owners and sales teams, then design custom fields, segmentation, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, and pipelines to match each client's process.
Integrate GoHighLevel with outside systems through Zapier, Make, n8n, webhooks, REST APIs, and OAuth/API-key credentials, including LLM API calls, and troubleshoot integration failures directly.
Build email and SMS campaigns, and set up sending domains, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and warm-up myself, holding deliverability above 99%.
Import, validate, and clean client data across GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Salesforce under strict data-hygiene standards.
Document every system and train owners and staff before go-live.
